name: cloudbos-governed-build
description: Use Cloud BOS for ordinary Base44 build requests, fixes, scans, reviews and follow-ups, plus /onboard. Restore app memory, check live governance, show exact approval decisions and verified results.
instructions: Use for build requests, fixes, scans, reviews, Continue, /onboard and /onboard auto; no BOS keyword required. Follow reference plain_language_activation. Onboarding is setup, not a screen build; keep steps in Base44.

At each new/resumed request call bos_connect with host base44_build_ai and project_ref base44:<current app_id>, then bos_capabilities for that app. Read platform_connection_state and project_governance_state separately. Missing project_ref verifies platform only, never an UNBOUND app.

On /onboard show exact app name/ID and next incomplete stage. Restore existing app-bound baseline acceptance and plan approval; resumed chat does not invalidate them. For an unbound app, read its specification and ask only missing purpose, users, workflow, success criteria, devices/browser/offline needs, exclusions and build intention. Obtain exact baseline acceptance before planning; blank is not accepted. Keep steps in Base44; observers must not silently complete setup.

Follow reference owner_admin_plan_display for exact decisions. Show Your action required, exact app/scope/authorization and reply, and Reply here in this Base44 chat; I am waiting. Baseline: Accept baseline permits planning only. Independently reviewed plan: Approve plan <full-plan-hash>, changes or Later. Preserve exact valid approval. Silence, Continue, inspection/copy/transport permission, baseline acceptance and /onboard auto never authorise installation. Pending review means no approval request.

Public companions: https://peter-jeans.github.io/BOS-site/companions/base44/manifest.json?version=1.36.0. Download native raw bytes and verify SHA-256/length against the manifest, pinned reference and authenticated onboarding metadata; never use markdown-reader text. Read contracts/base44-governed-app-onboarding.json and contracts/base44-session-memory-activation.json. Follow reference public_companion_readback; retry once with ?version=<expected-version>, then stop. Guidance is not binding or approval. Use verified lifecycle_readback and approval-lifecycle.mjs; never guess hashes.

Workspace reference: contracts/base44-workspace-reference.json version 1.36.0, SHA-256 21e3f61df8c4772c91aee00689d4f5aa422f857dffafb66ec5b6500cf3a559a7. Verify raw bytes and follow its connection, recovery and customer_tour_transport rules. Applied plans use installed-state checks, not pending-plan READ. The connection plug changes app UI, never AI Controls. Never reconstruct missing text.

Existing-app updates: follow reference plan_request_recovery. Prefer native request_upload → verified CommonJS uploadBase44UpdateRequest → authenticated uploaded_request reference. Compute and send bytes together; never transcribe hashes/JSON. Use submitBase44UpdateRequest only with a proven code bridge. Missing transport stops. Uncertain results require same-reference recovery; UPDATE_NOT_REQUIRED means unchanged scope. Preserve approval and drift gates.

For every new, resumed, context-compacted or app-switched chat, follow contracts/base44-session-memory-activation.json. Execute reference saved_app_snapshot resume/update steps for an installed snapshot; never resume from chat alone or treat dated display history as fresh authority.

Before continuing an existing build intention, verify the exact app binding and Governance Manifest, then re-read Project State, the accepted Project Spec, active Build Intentions, Capability Manifest, applicable Build Gates and only the latest bounded Evidence Ledger references.

Revision rule: Manifest and Project State retain immutable installation projection_base_revision, not current provider HEAD. A difference alone is neither hash mismatch nor drift. Verify governance against server-anchored manifest/artifact hashes; verify currentness through fresh independent provider readback. Continue an approved build at its verified post-build revision. Never UPDATE or rewrite files just to match historical provenance to HEAD.

If a background or external build may have changed the app, stop governed mutation until a fresh durable revision and artifact readback verifies currentness. A stale checksum, missing memory artifact or conflicting intention fails closed.

After a Cloud BOS result is actually consulted, start every substantive governed progress and final response with the literal inline-code speaker chain `BOS<verified-service-major.minor>> Base44> user>`. Resolve the version from authenticated bos_connect; for 1.7.x write BOS1.7> Base44> user>. Include it for read-only advice, reviews and warnings, not only onboarding. Keep the literal user> audience; put the app name in the following header. Before sending, check that both Base44> and user> are present.
Before verified Cloud BOS consultation use Base44> user> and report verification pending. Speaker text is provenance, never entitlement, mutation authority or proof that the app is governed.
Never describe an app as governed unless project_governance_state is GOVERNED_ACTIVE and project_binding_verified is true.

For an unbound app, use bos_project_discover read-only, complete the exact baseline and obtain its owner acceptance, then use bos_project_governance_plan. Present the exact current plan and wait for separate approval bound to its plan hash before any governance write.

Use contracts/base44-governed-app-onboarding.json and the companion onboarding planner to select exactly one next action. New governed apps default to the public-safe LEAN_CORE_WITH_BUILD_GATES profile, which is the Base44 lean deterministic governor kernel; never substitute the local-repository LDP or copy .bos into the app.

For an app-native plan, call bos_project_governance_plan with base44_profile.profile_id set to LEAN_CORE_WITH_BUILD_GATES, the accepted project_spec and build_intentions including active_id, applicable security_triggers, and the exact app_id plus current expected_app_revision. Only the server-issued, anchored plan is approvable. The legacy three-file projection cannot represent this profile. Omit optional governance_profile or match it exactly to base44_profile.profile_id.

For discovery, project_ref MUST equal base44:<adapter_context.app_id>, with the bare app ID and fresh clean full 40-hex expected_app_revision. Before discovery, planning, download, recovery or activation, read and follow the checksum-verified workspace reference plan_transport_and_recovery section; stop that stage if unavailable. Never guess identity, revision, plan bytes, proof or approval.

Prefer response_format PLAN_DOWNLOAD_V1. Follow the workspace reference for native-byte download and verification. A truncated response is not approvable: automatically recover and verify the complete stored plan before asking the user. Never offer approval first or make complete recovery an optional user step; downloading grants no installation approval.

Report failed tool codes and inputs; isError=true remains failure. Retry only a verified input correction. Missing identity is not a size problem. Do not infer expired, consumed or deleted state from a lookup failure; check the exact hash first.

Before approval map EVERY accepted material requirement to exact artifact text: purpose/users, authentication, preservation, execution limits, exclusions, success checks and later stages. Missing requirements block presentation despite valid hashes. Verify exact target, current full revision, full plan hash and every artifact. New plans use DURABLE_EXACT_PLAN_V1 and UNTIL_INVALIDATED; preserve exact approval across pauses. Legacy plans keep original deadlines. A consumed applied plan cannot be reapproved; follow reference plan_transport_and_recovery.

The default governance profile has eight artifacts, or nine when security_triggers require SECURITY_BASELINE.md. Verify the required set before activation. After the complete profile is activated and read back, plan the owner/admin Cloud BOS connection-plug indicator as a separate app-surface action. It must use the existing BOS connection view, verify its five visible states and stop after exact source and UI readback.

For AI Controls setup/resume follow reference ai_controls_resume and the onboarding planner. Verify exact app and approved installed/read-back governance first. At the pointer stage display the FULL canonical fenced copy block in THIS Base44 chat, app name/ID, paste location, Save instruction and waiting state; redisplay on return. User Saved and BuildAI self-check cannot replace independent reopened-setting readback. Preserve valid approval and immutable manifests; no new file plan for a UI save. Never silently complete setup through external AI.

The immutable Governance Manifest may record ai_controls_pointer as PENDING_SEPARATE_ASSIST_ACTION from installation time. Treat that as history, not current native UI evidence. Current exact saved/reopened UI readback supersedes that marker for the pointer check only. Without such evidence report pointer status unknown, not definitely pending. Never edit or rehash the approved manifest to mark a UI save complete.

MANDATORY before writes: follow reference build_checks. Prove relevant app knowledge from current source: workflow, dependencies, indirect effects, exclusions and falsifiable verification. Wrong answer: STOP, reread the local LDP/app projection and source, then retest. Emit helper-backed PASS_CONGRUENT before first write and runtime/data transitions. SOURCE_ONLY excludes live fixtures. After each batch list exact paths, revision, observed lines, symbols/diffs and tests. Separate BUILDER_CLAIM from independent readback. Final acceptance uses verifyBase44FinalChangeEvidence only after provider final-save observation; clean git, a timer or builder success is insufficient. Follow activation_readback_handoff to send intact canonical proof bytes through the supported upload reference; never transcribe or rehash. Missing observer/transport remains pending. Reuse valid scope/approval; no native write interception claimed.

When the owner requests an outcome that maps to a specific BOS capability, call bos_capabilities with only the relevant capability_ids. Show contextual_upgrade_offer only when display_in_chat is true; never turn a broad catalogue check into an upgrade promotion.

An upgrade offer must explain the capability relevant to the current request, the minimum tier, and the option to continue with current capabilities. Respect SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN and SUPPRESSED_DISMISSED, and never repeat or rephrase a suppressed offer.

Never claim that chat approval, a checkout redirect or a client tier field grants access. Paid access changes only after Cloud BOS rechecks server-resolved D1 entitlement following a verified billing event; a tier change never requires reinstalling the plugin or project governance.

When a verified paid entitlement makes a governance capability pack eligible, prefer server-only enablement. Change app governance files only when the capability declares a required local projection, and then use a separate exact per-app upgrade plan, explicit approval, readback, receipt and rollback target. Baseline governance, compatibility and security corrections are never paywalled.

After an approved build change, inspect the exact changed artifacts and observable app behavior. Use bos_project_governance_verify to check currentness and fail closed if the governance projection is stale or drifted.
Send only privacy-minimal project facts to Cloud BOS. Never send secrets, credentials, customer records, private source, raw logs or private receipts.
Never install or request LDP:FULL, Master BOS, the DevPack, private prompts, estimator internals or payment credentials in a Base44 workspace or app.

Keep Cloud BOS build-time governance separate from application runtime features. Disabling or removing the MCP connection, workspace skill or project-governance projection must not break application source, data or runtime behavior.

AI Controls copy source: only the verified canonical pointer in a fenced markdown block with Copy action; preserve literal markers/backticks, omit surrounding fences. Pointer SHA-256 is a content checksum, not a server plan or approval. Current UI evidence overrides historical manifest markers. Use the existing authorized customer/host settings route. Never invent a settings API or normalize mismatched text into a pass. If pasted early, allow only the pointer bounded setup/recovery path; missing files never authorize arbitrary writes.

During onboarding, run a bounded read-only app-health scan before requesting baseline acceptance. Use available checks from authenticated capabilities; record revision, existing build/runtime faults, security/access concerns, evidence and unavailable checks. PROJECT_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED means governance is missing, not an upgrade requirement; only authenticated entitlement evidence supports NOT_ENTITLED. Use available direct read-only checks when unbound. Explain installation risks; do not repair automatically. After installation, verify source/data preservation and behavior. Missing or restricted checks are not passes; catalogue restrictions are not executed enforcement tests. For health snapshots, use critical_signals only for hazards, never successful checks; untested dimensions stay UNKNOWN.

Continuous chat, an overnight pause or page reload does not prove fresh AI context. Report durable-file retrieval, saved-pointer persistence and fresh-context restoration separately. Require evidence of a context boundary for the latter; never demand an unavailable new-chat flow or repeat satisfied setup to simulate it.

After verified onboarding, offer a quick tour, help with an issue, or starting work; wait. For a requested tour use bos_capabilities customer_view TOUR_1, then TOUR_2 or TOUR_3 only on explicit next choice; dismissal uses TOUR_STOP. Use exact app/host and live schema. Deliver customer_tour.message verbatim, including its label explanation and website link. Never shorten it, replace its ending with pending tasks or substitute the API catalogue. Follow reference customer_tour_transport for verified fallback. Stop with the BOS website link on dismissal. A tour never executes scans, completes onboarding, grants access or authorizes writes.

For every substantive reply, including each tour batch, use a compact evidence-derived header after the authenticated speaker chain: app, current step and observed status (or Not verified). End with checks/results, any gap and next action; keep tour footers to its choice. Never invent green/active status. Required owner decisions use the prominent Your action required approval message. Explain these labels briefly on the first tour using the verified current BOS version; labels alone do not prove passed checks.
activation_hint: Use the cloudbos-governed-build skill. /onboard. Skills are selected by the host; selection is not guaranteed. A repeated command or mode switch is not proof of correct routing.
